runtime_proof.note: Both defects were measured in production, not inferred from tests. Containment was not changed. The deploy of this fix is reserved decision 8 and was NOT dispatched.

queries.name: the production receipt discards the delivered channel
queries.method: read-only SELECT against production zfzdnfwdarxucxtaojxm on distribution_receipts joined to distribution_outbox
queries.result: receipt 653db135-cfa0-427d-83a7-d5d7da78a299 on outbox 684ba33f-45c4-4a80-adf0-db8286c90815: target='discord:official-picks', channel='discord:official-picks', external_id='1550376792987140208', payload.channelId='1384052464189440120'
queries.significance: The channel actually POSTed to survives only in payload.channelId. receipt.channel is not numeric and human targets are exempt from UNIT_TALK_DISCORD_TARGET_MAP by UTV2-1923, so resolveRecapChannel could never resolve it.

queries.name: the recap refusal reproduced through the intended operator payload
queries.method: POST /api/picks/816a84c7-58b8-4585-8e7a-7ad1e036342e/settle with the exact body apps/command-center/src/app/actions/settle.ts sends
queries.significance: The defect is on the live path, not a hypothetical.

queries.name: the API never registered the Command Center bearer
queries.method: read the API container's own process environment and every per-SHA .env.production snapshot on the production host; probe api.unit-talk.com from the Command Center container
queries.result: UNIT_TALK_CC_API_KEY absent from every .env.production the workflow has written; the API's registered keys are UNIT_TALK_BOT_API_KEY (submitter) and UNIT_TALK_INGESTOR_API_KEY (settler); Command Center -> API /api/picks/:id/trace returned 401
queries.significance: Every Command Center write path was unreachable. No secret value was read at any point.

queries.name: the host repair confirms the diagnosis and is transient
queries.method: append the UNIT_TALK_CC_API_KEY line from .env.command-center to .env.production (backup at .env.production.pre-ccapikey-repair), docker compose up -d --force-recreate --no-deps api, re-probe
queries.significance: Confirms the missing key was the sole cause. deploy.yml rewrites .env.production on every deploy, so this edit does not survive; the workflow change in this PR is what makes it durable.

queries.name: containment readback after the lifecycle proof
queries.method: read-only SELECT against production: kill switch, outbox totals, governed cohort
queries.result: official-picks/best-bets/trader-insights/exclusive-insights all killed=true; distribution_outbox total 5747 unchanged, newest 2026-07-30 20:04:41; 0 rows sent during the window; 7 governed picks
queries.significance: The kill switch was released for 2.4 seconds through the governed POST /api/discord/kill-switch route with zero pending/claimed/retry/failed rows confirmed beforehand, then re-engaged. Nothing could fire and nothing did.
